answer: Only accounts older than 300 epochs may sponsor newcomers, two per 60 epochs, and the ledger records each link in the nebula sponsor tree. The sponsor locks 40 × 2^s crystal, where s counts keys already in its subtree, so each next fake costs double the last. A clone proof filed to the ivory dispute log makes the ledger slash every bond in that subtree. Age accrues one epoch at a time and can't be bought, shared or grown in parallel, so a farm compounds its own risk.
